title: Enact library skill
description: One version of a skill in the environment's skill library, packaged from its directory: the manifest from skill.json and the text of every other file, by its path inside the skill directory. docs/agent-contract.md, "The skill library", describes each field.

name.description: The skill's directory name; agents lay it out at skills/<name>/.

version.description: Semantic version without build metadata. Immutable once saved.

files.description: Every file of the skill directory except skill.json, by its path inside the directory, as UTF-8 text. SKILL.md is required.
